text:
Senior engineers don't just write code—they carry the weight of the entire system lifecycle on their shoulders.

Building a feature is usually the easy part. 

The real weight comes from everything surrounding it:

- Balancing urgent business deadlines with long-term technical debt
- Designing architectures built for scale, security, and uptime
- Mentoring team members while resolving production incidents
- Maintaining legacy edge cases that no one else remembers

Writing code is just the tip of the iceberg. 

It’s managing the invisible complexity underneath that takes the real toll.
